contract.software_preview_coordinate_conversion: Gecko-style X reflection only; Z unchanged. Front camera yaw180 looks toward -Z, i.e. sees +Z face.
contract.warning: Do not translate along local -Z or add an extra Y180. That would reverse the stance-speed agreement. If caller rotates by Y180 for any other convention, rotate velocity with the same matrix too.
contract.evidence_scope: Static code audit of source geo, local ScenicModels wrapper, software foot-contact math and upstream 1.20.1 Forge renderer/factory source. No native bake or game executed; main native orientation check still required.

findings: BakedModelFactory flips X origin and pivot; leaves Z unchanged. Bone/cube rotation signs match local preview.

Local ScenicModels applies only packet yaw atan2(x,z), no global Y180. #4 binding not yet implemented.
Stance foot local -Z motion is exactly countered by +Z world movement at .01m/tick; validated over 81 sampled poses.
